text: Default-deny every actor, action, resource, workspace, and environment unless an explicit current policy permits it.
Bind admission, plan, approval, queue work, execution, provider identity, observation, and audit to stable workspace, environment, resource, generation, and operation identifiers.
Reauthorize before provider effects; a stale plan, revoked actor, expired credential, lost fence, or changed generation cannot execute.
Never persist or emit raw user or provider credentials in resources, plans, queues, state, fixtures, logs, traces, metrics, errors, or support output.
Treat every external request, desired-state document, queue delivery, provider response, webhook, restore input, and artifact as untrusted and size-bound.
Commit accepted state, integrity evidence, required audit data, and outbox work atomically; duplicate delivery never becomes duplicate logical effect.
Separate runtime, migration, read-only, audit, backup, integrity, administration, redrive, build, and release authority.
Encrypt control-plane and provider traffic, persistent state, backups, and retained audit data; verify the peer and intended destination.
Bound per-workspace consumption, global concurrency, provider calls, telemetry volume/cardinality, retained bytes, and external cost.
Require retained test or operational evidence before changing a design requirement into an implemented security claim.
